column1: # The README capture, one row per scene, in order (desktop/capture/capture.sh runs
# scene_<id>, shoots, then leave_<id> when there is one; assemble.py shows each shot for
# need: required fails the capture when the scene is not on screen in time; optional
# leaves it out with a warning. what: what is on screen, for the job summary.

column4: Hyprland after login: the trust bar with no session, the Ward Dark wallpaper
wardos-welcome keys: the keys menu, both keys not set
ward init ~/ward-demo in the terminal the project step opens
wardos-welcome agent: the agent menu for ~/ward-demo
ward up ~/ward-demo in a terminal; the trust bar goes live
the command centre's Resume session: ward watch beside the session terminal, the welcome toast
wardos-menu: the command centre with the live session
wardos-theme set tokyo-night: bar, wallpaper and toast in Tokyo Night
